description: Every core overload evaluated at run time on root values, so that no case is folded at compile time (PXL-006, PXL-007).

cases.name: int mul min by minus one
int div min by minus one
decimal digits limit
cases.expr: dec * dec * dec * dec * dec * dec * dec * dec * dec * dec * dec * dec * dec * dec * dec * dec * dec * dec * dec * dec

cases.name: addDays dateTime keeps the local time
isBefore and isAfter
cases.expr: [isBefore(day, addDays(day, 1)), isAfter(day, day), isBefore(when, when), isAfter(when, addDays(when, -1))]

cases.name: in list and map
cases.expr: [i in nums, 3 in nums, "a" in scores, s in tags]

cases.name: string of scalars
cases.expr: [string(i), string(x), string(true && one == 1), string(dec), string(price), string(day), string(when), string(dur), string(tint), string(mode)]

cases.name: isEmail
cases.expr: [isEmail("a.b+c@example.com" + e), isEmail("a..b@example.com" + e), isEmail("ab@example" + e), isEmail("ab@-x.com" + e), isEmail("ä@example.com" + e), isEmail("ab@example.c0m" + e), isEmail(".a@b.cd" + e), isEmail("a b@c.de" + e)]
